scope: Conservative BBJ Hashimoto cleaning and coordinate/allele harmonisation only; no replication, heterogeneity, LD, or colocalisation analyses.
multi_record_position_policy: Verify numeric chromosome-position ordering before any adjacent grouping. If not ordered, use SQLite position counts; exclude every row at every multi-record source or target position without first/best-P selection.
palindromic_policy: Exclude all A/T and C/G pairs; do not infer orientation from cross-ancestry EAF.
lift_policy: Exactly one total forward mapping; primary autosome unchanged; width one; exact unique coordinate and strand roundtrip; reject target-position collisions.
allele_policy: BBJ effect_allele and other_allele are reported study alleles, not claimed REF/ALT. Complement both only on a negative lift strand. Match transformed BBJ EA/OA exactly to FinnGen ALT/REF (direct) or REF/ALT (swap); only swap negates beta and transforms EAF to 1-EAF.
sample_size_policy: Do not fabricate per-variant N, case/control counts, MAC, or Rsq. bbj_n_total is NA for every row; cohort 537 cases and 172656 controls are metadata only.
